benchmark_metadata.source: Baymard Institute Global Meta-Analysis + Regional Central Bank Reports (SAMA, ECB, Fed, RBI, BCB)
benchmark_metadata.lifetime_validation_mandate: If running in a future year (e.g. 2027+), the AI Agent MUST use search_web with the queries provided in 'dynamic_search_queries' to update these benchmarks.

top_abandonment_causes.cause: Extra costs too high (shipping, taxes, fees revealed late)
top_abandonment_causes.remedy: Display estimated shipping fees early in cart or header before checkout

top_abandonment_causes.cause: Site wanted me to create an account (Forced Registration)
top_abandonment_causes.remedy: Implement 1-click Guest Checkout and offer password creation post-purchase

top_abandonment_causes.cause: Checkout process too long / complicated (Form Fatigue)
top_abandonment_causes.remedy: Consolidate into single-step accordion or 1-page checkout, auto-fill address

top_abandonment_causes.cause: Didn't trust the site with credit card info
top_abandonment_causes.remedy: Add recognizable payment gateway badges (Apple Pay, Mada, SSL badges, commercial register)
Provide clear delivery date windows (e.g. 'Delivered by Thursday') instead of vague '3-5 days'
Offer localized payment methods (Apple Pay, Mada, Tabby/Tamara, Fawry, COD, iDEAL, BLIK)

top_abandonment_causes.cause: Website had errors / crashed / timed out
top_abandonment_causes.remedy: Fix API latency, remove heavy third-party tracking scripts, ensure fast checkout server response

US.tax_mandate: Automatic state/local sales tax calculation by 5-digit ZIP code (Avalara / TaxJar).
US.market_share_insights: Express wallet checkout (Shop Pay / Apple Pay) increases checkout conversion by up to 35% by skipping shipping/billing entry.

UK.regulatory_mandate: SCA / 3D Secure 2.0 mandatory under UK banking regulations.

DE.market_share_insights: German consumers traditionally prefer paying after receiving goods (Rechnung). Direct credit card entry has lower adoption than PayPal/Klarna.

NL.market_share_insights: If an online store lacks iDEAL in the Netherlands, checkout abandonment typically exceeds 70%.

mandatory_methods: BLIK (>70% of all mobile and web transactions)
PL.market_share_insights: BLIK (6-digit instant mobile code) is the undisputed king of Polish eCommerce.

FR.regulatory_mandate: Strict compliance with EU GDPR: consent checkboxes cannot be pre-checked.

BR.market_share_insights: Pix has become the fastest-growing payment method in LATAM history.

mandatory_methods: UPI (Unified Payments Interface >80% share via PhonePe/GPay/Paytm)
IN.market_share_insights: UPI QR code and mobile app intent triggers dominate checkouts.

legacy_methods: Cash on Delivery (الدفع عند الاستلام - Dropped below 15%)
SA.market_share_insights: Mada drives over 69.3 billion SAR quarterly. Apple Pay dominates mobile/in-app checkouts. Stores without BNPL suffer noticeable abandonment.

EG.market_share_insights: COD remains dominant (>50%), but Instapay and mobile wallets represent the highest growth velocity.

AE.market_share_insights: Digital wallet penetration exceeds 70% in retail eCommerce.

KW.market_share_insights: KNET is mandatory for high conversion in Kuwait.
